title: ENOUGH IS ENOUGH YOUR BAD DAYS ARE OVER SAYS THE LORD
text: Something shifted the moment this gathering came together. And I need you to feel it before I say another word. There is a sound in the spirit right now that does not sound like worship, does not sound like prayer. It sounds like a gavvel coming down. Somewhere in heaven, a file has just been stamped. And the word written across that file is not wait. It is not maybe next year. It is one word final and settled enough. I see a man standing at a mile marker. He has passed so many times. He could draw it from memory. The same income, the same title, the same unanswered application, the same stalled negotiation, the same argument with his own body about why it will not heal. Round and round, year after year, like a man on a track with no finish line, convinced that motion equals progress, when really he has just been getting better at running in place. God is not asking you to run faster on that same track tonight. God is lifting you off it completely. Somebody open your mouth right now before I even give you an instruction and say, "I receive it enough." Say it like a person who is exhausted of explaining the same stagnant testimony to people who ask, "So how far with that thing now?" Say it like a person who has rehearsed the excuse so many times it no longer convinces even them enough. Not soon, not in due time. Though that phrase is true in its season, but tonight the season itself is what's ending. God is not promising you a better lap around the same mountain. He is promising you the mountain is over. Let's go straight into his presence because I did not come to entertain anybody tonight. Lift your hands and let's pray before we even unpack the word. Father, we come to you right now acknowledging that we have grown so familiar with delay that we stopped being offended by it. We ask you to restore our holy dissatisfaction. Not the dissatisfaction that complains, but the dissatisfaction that refuses to accept a lower version of what you have already released. Wake up the hunger that has gone to sleep inside your people in the name of Jesus. I decree over somebody listening right now, the deadline on your waiting has arrived. Every cycle designed to keep you cuckling the same coordinates, the same relationship pattern, the same financial ceiling, the same spiritual plateau is [music] terminated as of this moment in the name of Jesus. Turn with your spirit if not your hands to Deuteronomy 1:6. Moses is recounting 40 years later the exact words God [music] spoke to an entire generation camped at a mountain called Horeb. The Lord our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, "Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount." Pause there. God did not say that mountain was cursed. He did not say the camp was sinful or the view was bad. He simply said they had been there long enough. Sometimes the problem with your current location is not that it's wicked, is that it has expired. You can be in a perfectly legitimate season [music] and still be dangerously overdue to leave it. Church, that verse is not ancient history. That is a prophetic mirror. Some of you are camped at a perfectly reasonable mountain, reasonable job, reasonable relationship status, reasonable level of faith, reasonable income, and reasonable has become the enemy of your actual assignment. Because reasonable was only ever meant to be a resting point, not a residence. Deuteronomy 2:3 repeats the same charge a few chapters later. In case the first instruction wasn't loud enough, ye have compassed this mountain long enough. Turn you northward. Twice in the same book, God interrupts a generation's comfortable cackling with the same four words. Long enough move. I feel something rising. This is not a sermon about ambition. This is not about huzzle. Not about chasing titles for the sake of applause. This is about alignment. about the gap between where you currently are and where the blueprint over your life said you'd be by now. And tonight, God is closing that gap by force. Not by your effort alone, but by divine interruption. Let's look at a man in John chapter 5 lying by a pool called Bethesda for 38 years. 38 years is not a short season. That is a lifetime for some people reading this. And Jesus walks up to him and asks a question that sounds almost insulting on the surface. Will thou be made whole? Of course, he wants to be made whole. Why else would a paralyzed man lie beside a healing pool for nearly four decades? [music] But Jesus wasn't questioning his desire. He was exposing his adjustment. Verse 7 tells us the man's answer. Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool. He had built an entire explanation system around why this was simply his portion. He wasn't lying by the pool fighting for his miracle anymore. He was lying by the pool managing his disappointment. Somebody here has built a very articulate, very reasonable explanation for why you are still at this level. You [music] can defend it beautifully. You know all the reasons, the economy, the family you were born into, the people who failed you, the doors that closed, and every reason might even be true. But Jesus didn't argue with the man's explanation. He bypassed it entirely and gave him a command that made the explanation irrelevant. Rise, take up thy bed, and walk. I speak that same word over you tonight. Not an argument against your excuse, but an instruction that makes the excuse obsolete. Rise. Let the fire of God fall on every well rehearsed explanation for stagnation in this house tonight. I don't care how reasonable it sounds. Reasonable is not the same as final. In the name of Jesus, I decree every 38-year pattern, every cycle that has outlived his purpose and become an identity breaks right now in the name of Jesus. [music] Somebody needs to hear this next part clearly because it would change how you pray for the rest of this service. The problem at Bethesda wasn't only the man's condition. It was his proximity to a miracle he kept missing by seconds. Verse four, in some manuscripts describes an angel troubling the water at a certain season, and whoever stepped in first was healed. This man wasn't far from breakthrough. He was close enough to see it happen for other people repeatedly while his own moment kept slipping past him because somebody else always stepped in first. That is a specific kind of pain watching the exact miracle you're praying for happen for someone else in front of you. If that's you tonight, [music] I need you to release whatever bitterness has quietly built up in you from watching others step into what felt like your water. Let it go right now. Because what Jesus is about to do for you does not require a pool, does not require timing, does not require you to be faster than anybody else. He's about to bypass the system that kept failing you and deal with you directly. Let somebody declare out loud, I no longer need the pool. I have the pool maker. Church, let's go back further to Genesis chapter 26. Isaac is in the land during a famine, the exact same famine his father Abraham had once fled from by going to Egypt. And God tells Isaac something unusual. Stay. Don't run to Egypt like your father did. So John in this land and I will be with you and I will bless you. Verse 12 records what happened next. Then Isaac sowed in that land and received in the same year and 100fold and the Lord blessed him. Read that again. The same year, not after 7 years of patient toil, not after a generational wait. The same year he sowed in the middle of a famine, he reaped hundfold. I decree that same year harvest over somebody tonight. Stop calculating your breakthrough on the old timeline. The famine conditions around you right now are not a prophecy of your future. They are simply the backdrop against which God is about to do something so sudden it embarrasses the delay that came before it. Let's keep moving because the fire is building. Numbers chapter 14 records the tragic alternative to Deuteronomy's instruction. [music] an entire generation that he had the report of giants in the land and chose fear over advancement. God's response in that chapter is sobering. He granted their request. He let them stay in the wilderness exactly as long as they feared they would have to. 40 years, one year for every day the spies had explored the land. Church, I want you to understand something sobering tonight. Sometimes what feels like delay from the enemy is actually agreement from heaven with a request you made in fear years ago. A request you don't even remember making. I'll never get that chance again. This is probably as far as someone like me goes. Maybe this is just my portion. Those were prayers. God in his justice sometimes honors the prayer of fear the same way he honors the prayer of faith because he will not violate your will. I renounce every prayer of fear I have ever prayed over my own life whether I remember praying it or not in the name of Jesus. I cancel every agreement I unknowingly made with limitation in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout it with me. Cancelled. Joshua chapter 1 opens with a death and a declaration in the same breath. Now after the death of Moses, the servant of the Lord, it came to pass that the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying, Moses, my servant, is dead. Now therefore, arise, go over this Jordan. There is something your current level needed to die before your next level could legally begin. Sometimes God is not slow. Sometimes he's waiting for you to bury something. An old identity, [music] an old title, an old version of yourself that served its purpose and now must be honored and released, not dragged into the next assignment. What Moses in your story needs to die tonight so that arise can be spoken over you without contradiction. Let every attachment to an expired season be caught now in the name of Jesus. I decree [music] a clean, honorable burial over every chapter that has already closed so that resurrection power can be released over the chapter that is opening. Let's look at four men in 2 Kings chapter 7. Lepers sitting at the gate of a besieged city caught between a famine inside the walls and an army outside them. Verse three records their reasoning out loud. Why sit we here until we die? They examine every available option. Go into the city. [music] We die of famine. Sit here. We die of hunger anyway. Surrender to the enemy camp. At worst we die. At best we leave. And verse four ends with a decision that should be preached in every house tonight. Now therefore, come and let us fall onto the host of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we shall live. And if they kill us, we shall but die. They moved toward uncertainty because certainty was already killing them slowly. And when they arrived at the enemy camp, they discovered God had already caused the army to flee, leaving behind more provision than the entire starving city could use. Somebody here has been sitting at a gate, reasoning yourself into stillness because every option in front of you looks risky. I want you to hear what those lepers understood that we often forget. Staying still is not actually the safe option you think it is. Certainty at this level is still slowly killing something in you. Your confidence, your faith, your capacity to dream, the four lepers didn't have a strategy. They had a decision. Rise and go. And the moment they rose, before they even reached the camp, verse 6 tells us God had already made the enemy hear a noise of chariots and a noise of horses. Even the noise of a great host that caused them to flee in panic over nothing but a sound. Church, sometimes the resistance that has been guarding your next level is more fragile than it looks. It does not need you to defeat it. It only needs you to move toward it because the sound of your advance backed by heaven is already enough to scatter what's been blocking you. I decree over somebody listening right now, rise and go. Whatever has kept you reasoning at the gate, I interrupt that reasoning tonight in the name of Jesus. Let every obstacle standing between you and your next level hear the sound of an approaching host and flee before you even arrive in the name of Jesus. Let's move to Luke chapter 5 where Peter has fished all night and caught nothing. a professional fisherman on his own lake using his own boat, failing at the one thing he knew better than anyone else in that region. And Jesus tells him something that must have sounded almost absurd to a tired, discouraged professional. Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a draft. Peter's response carries the exhaustion of someone who has already tried. Master, we have toiled all the night and have taken nothing. But then comes the hinge of the whole story. Nevertheless, at thy word, I will let down the net. [music] And the catch was so great, the net began to break. Church, some of you have toiled all night at this level. [music] You have tried the strategy, applied the advice, followed the formula, and still come up with nothing in the net. I am not here to give you a new strategy tonight. I am here to tell you to launch into the deep [music] at his word one more time. Not because the method changed, but because the word behind it did. Nevertheless, that is the posture of somebody about to break through after a night of nothing. Nevertheless, at your word, I will let down the net again. Let the fire of God fall on every spirit of fishing fatigue in this house. Every person tempted to pull the boat in and call it quits right before the breakthrough catch, I speak fresh strength into your arms tonight in the name of Jesus. There's a reason Isaiah 54:2 commands, "Enlarge the place of thy tent. Lengthen thy cords and strengthen thy stakes." You do not enlarge a tent you are about to abandon. God only tells you to widen your capacity when he is preparing to fill it. I decree that instruction over your life tonight. Enlarge your expectation. Lengthen the cords of your vision. Strengthen the stakes of your confidence. Because what is coming will require more room than your current level was built to hold. Hagi 2:9 declares a promise over a people who were grieving the loss of a former glory. The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former. Somebody has been quietly mourning a season that ended a job, a relationship, a ministry platform, a version of your life that used to work and doesn't anymore. I decree tonight that the house you are walking into carries more glory than the house you are leaving. Stop decorating the memory of the old house. The new one is already greater. Habacook 2:es 2 and 3 instruct the prophet to write the vision and make it plain. Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come. I decree that every vision some of you have stopped writing down because it felt embarrassing to still be believing for it is being reactivated tonight. Pick the pen back up. The taring was never a cancellation notice. This is where the prayer needs to rise because teaching without warfare just produces better informed stagnant people. Let's pray. Father, in the authority of the name of Jesus, we petition heaven for acceleration over destiny tonight. Every assignment that has been stuck in processing, promotions delayed in approval, visas delayed in review, contracts delayed in signature, ministries delayed in platform. I decree sudden movement in the name of Jesus. Isaiah 60:1 declares, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come [music] and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee." I speak that arising over every dormant assignment tonight. I decree over families represented in this house, every generational ceiling broken. Some of you come from bloodlines where a certain level has never been exceeded. Nobody in your family has owned a home. Nobody has finished a particular degree. Nobody has left a particular region. Nobody has broken a cycle of a particular addiction or abuse. I speak to that invisible ceiling now. Crack in the name of Jesus. You are not bound to repeat the furthest point your family has ever reached. 1st Chronicles 4:10 records the prayer of a man named Jabz, who refused the limitation written into his very name, a name that men sorrow, and cried out, "Oh, that thou wouldest bless me indeed, [music] and enlarge my coast." And the scripture says plainly, God granted him that which he requested. I decree that same enlarging over every family coastline represented here tonight. more territory, more capacity, more influence than your household has ever carried before. For every marriage in this house, sackling the same unresolved argument, the same emotional distance, the same season of going through the motions without genuine connection, I decree a fresh wind tonight. Song of Solomon 2:1 says, "For lo, the winter is passed. The rain is over and gone. Every marital winter that has overstayed its welcome, I command it to lift in the name of Jesus. Every root of offense that has quietly calcified into distance dissolve now. Let affection that has gone cold be rekindled. Let communication that has broken down be restored. And let every third party, human, financial, or spiritual assign to keep a marriage stuck at this current level be exposed and removed. For those still believing for marriage, still watching peers celebrate anniversaries while you remain in the same unattached season year after year. I decree the waiting is not a verdict on your worth. Genesis chapter 2 shows us that Adam named every animal before his own suitable helper was ever presented. Which tells us delay is sometimes simply sequence, not rejection. Your sequence is completing now. I decree divine encounter properly timed and properly positioned in the name of Jesus. Let's pray over finances because many of you are at this exact level specifically because of a financial ceiling that has outlived its assignment. Malachi 3:10 speaks of windows of heaven open so wide there would not be room enough to receive it. I decree those windows open over your income, your business, your investments tonight. Every financial gate that has been padlocked by fear, by past mismanagement, by curses spoken over your lineage's ability to prosper, I command it open in the name of Jesus. I speak to every small container believing for a big poor. 2 Kings chapter 4 tells the story of a widow instructed by Elisha to borrow vessels, not a few. The oil that multiplied in her house stopped multiplying the exact moment she ran out of empty vessels to pour it into. Church, some of you have been praying for increase while only preparing for the same amount you've always had. I decree an enlargement of your capacity tonight. Enlarge your thinking. Enlarge your plans. Enlarge the vessels you are preparing to receive into because the oil is not the problem. Your containers have been too small for what's coming. Let somebody declare boldly, I am enlarging my capacity tonight in the name of Jesus. Before we pray for the body, I need to [music] plant one more picture in your spirit because it will change the way you receive what's coming. Ezekiel chapter 37 opens with the prophet sat down in the middle of a valley full of bones, not fresh casualties. But verse 2 specifically notes, they were very dry. Meaning this was an old defeat, a long settled stagnation, the kind of death nobody expected to reverse anymore. And God asked Ezekiel a question that sounds almost like a test. Son of man, can these bones leave? Ezekiel's answer is the most honest answer a tired believer can give. Oh Lord God, thou knowest. Not yes, absolutely not no. Impossible, just an honest admission that the outcome was beyond his own assessment. God doesn't need Ezekiel's certainty. He needs his obedience. He tells him to prophesy to the bones. And as Ezekiel speaks, verse 7 records a noise, and behold, a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone. Senu formed, flesh covered them, skin wrapped them. But verse 8 ends with a haunting detail. There was no breath in them. They had form without function. They looked restored, but they weren't alive yet. Church, some of you have gotten your situation to look restored on the outside. The resume looks fine. The marriage looks stable. The ministry looks active, but there's no breath in it. No life, no fire. You are going through the motions of a level you've already outgrown in your spirit. Even if the structure looks intact, God tells Ezekiel to prophesy again, this time to the breath itself. [music] Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon this slain that they may live. And verse 10 says, they lived and stood up upon their feet an exceeding great army. That is what tonight is for. Not just rearranging the bones of your current level to look a little better. Breath. I prophesy breath over every dry formed but lifeless situation in this house right now. [music] Let what has had the shape of life without the substance of it receive breath from the four winds in the name of Jesus. Rise up not as a slightly improved version of where you've been stuck, but as an exceeding great army, more capacity, more authority, more fire than this level ever contained. Let somebody shout it. Breathe. Paul gives us the posture to carry into this moment in Philippians chapter 3 13 and 14. forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forth onto those things which are before. I press toward the mark for the price of the high calling of God. Notice it doesn't say ignore the past or deny it happened. He says forget it in the sense of releasing its grip on your pace. You cannot run forward at full speed while your neck is turned backward evaluating everything that already happened. Isaiah chapter 43 18 and 19 says it even more directly. Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Something new is already springing. The question is whether you are still too busy reviewing old footage to notice it growing. I decree over every person in this house your eyes are turning forward tonight in the name of Jesus. Every review obsession, every mental replay of what could have been, release it now and let your whole attention turn toward what God is already doing ahead of you. Now, let's pray for health because the body can plateau exactly the way destiny can. Some of you have been managing a condition for years, medicating a symptom without addressing a root, accepting a diagnosis as a permanent sentence rather than a prison report. Jeremiah 30:17 says, "For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, said the Lord. I decree restoration over every body represented here tonight. Every condition that has plattered without improvement or decline, I command it to move, move toward total healing in the name of Jesus. >> Every organ functioning below capacity be restored to full function. Every chronic fatigue that has no clear medical explanation, lift now in the name of Jesus. Let's address covenants, causes, and evil altars directly. Because some plateaus are not natural. They are legally enforced by agreements made before you were even born. I decree that every covenant assigned to cap your progress at a certain level, financial ceilings written into ancestral agreements, marital delay, curses spoken by jilted lovers or rejected sutors in prior generations, health limitations tied to vows made at shrines by desperate ancestors is broken by the blood of Jesus. tonight. Colossians chapter 2:14 declares that Christ blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us. Took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross. Every handwritten ordinance against your advancement nailed to the cross and cancelled in the name of Jesus. I decree the destruction of every evil altar assigned [music] to monitor your growth and trigger sabotage the moment you approach a new level. [music] Every time you have gotten close to a breakthrough only to watch it collapse through strange almost coincidental circumstances. a sudden illness right before an interview, an unexplainable falling out right before a deal closes, a technical failure right before an opportunity. I expose that pattern tonight and command the altar behind it to be consumed by fire in the name of Jesus. Let's call on angelic intervention [music] because Daniel chapter 10 shows us that sometimes a breakthrough is already released in the spirit but delayed in its arrival by resistance in the unseen realm. The angel that came to Daniel explained he had been resisted by the prince of Persia for 21 days before Michael came to assist. Daniel's answer had been released the moment he began praying. It simply had to fight through territory to reach him. I decree reinforcement angels dispatch right now over every delayed answer in this house. Whatever has been resisting your breakthrough in transit, I call for angelic breakthrough that arrives ahead of schedule in the name of Jesus. Let's confront witchcraft because stagnation is sometimes not spiritual laziness. It is active assignment. I speak to every witchcraft altar that has specifically targeted your rising, every covenant meeting held to strategize how to keep you exactly WHERE YOU ARE, SCATTER now in the name of Jesus. I command every spiritual padlock placed on your next door to be destroyed by fire. Every dream where you were climbing a staircase that never ended, [music] running toward a destination that kept moving further away, or being pulled backward by an unseen hand. I declare those symbols reversed and nullified in the name of Jesus. I address specifically the spirit of the near miss. The pattern where breakthrough approaches almost to completion and then collapses at the final stage. The job offer that gets withdrawn after the final interview, the deal that falls apart at the signing table, the relationship that ends right before the proposal, I call that pattern by name tonight. And I command it to release its grip permanently in the name of Jesus. No more near misses. From this hour, what approaches you arrives and stays in the name of Jesus. I decree the exposure of every household enemy, every relative, whether living or deceased, in influence, who has spoken words over your life, designed to [music] keep you small, you'll never amount to anything. People like us don't get that far. Who do you think you are? Every one of those words spoken in jealousy, in bitterness, in their own unresolved pain, I nullify tonight by a greater word, the word of God over your life, which says, "You are the head and not the tail, above only and not beneath." According to Deuteronomy 28:13, I decree that word supersedes every other word spoken over you in the name of Jesus. Let every satanic surveillance assignment over your life be blinded tonight. 2 Kings chapter 6 tells us that when the king of Syria sent a great army to capture one man, Elisha prayed, "Smite these people, I pray thee with blindness." And God did exactly that, leading the entire army by the hand into the wrong city. I pray that same blindness over every spiritual force tracking your rise with the intention of stopping it early. Let them lose your coordinates tonight in the name of Jesus. Let them strategize against a version of you that no longer exists because you have already moved past where they last saw you. Let's pray for time and virtue restoration because years spent at the same level can feel like years wasted. And the enemy wants you to carry that as shame rather than as testimony material. Joel 2:25 promises, I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten. I decree that every year spent circling this mountain is being redeemed, not erased. Redeemed meaning the lessons, the character, the depth you gained while waiting will now become fuel for how well you steward what's coming. Nothing about this season was wasted. [music] Even the parts that felt wasted. I speak strength back into every weary soul in this house. Isaiah 40:29 says, "He giveth power to the faint, and to them that have no might, he increasth strength." Receive fresh strength now in the name of Jesus. [music] Let's pray for divine preservation because new levels come with new attacks. And I will not release you into elevation without also covering you against what elevation attracts. Psalm 91:10 declares, "There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling." I decree that same preservation over you as you step into this new level. Preserve from the jealousy your increase will provoke. Preserve from the exposure your visibility will bring. Preserve from the pride that sometimes accompanies rapid advancement. Keep us low at the feet of Jesus even as you lift us high in the sight of men. I want to speak a few specific words now. Receive what belongs to you. There is someone who has been offered a position they feel unqualified for and has been quietly stalling the decision out of fear. Take it. The qualification is growing into the role. Not arriving already finished. Someone has a business plan sitting in a drawer or a notes app for over 2 years waiting for the right time. The right time started 18 months ago begin this week even imperfectly. There is a person whose current employer has been undervaluing them for a long time and they already suspected but have been afraid to ask for what they are worth. Ask the answer may surprise you. Somebody has been waiting on a specific relative to apologize before they can move forward emotionally. Release the requirement. Your healing does not need their cooperation. There is a student who keeps choosing the safe course of study instead of the one they actually feel pulled toward. This is your semester to switch. Somebody's rent or mortgage situation is about to shift in your favor. A reduction, a renegotiation, or a better offer altogether within the next 2 months. There is a man who has been secretly ashamed of how long is taking him to recover financially after a major loss. God says the shame is not yours to carry. The comparison you're measuring yourself against was never accurate to begin with. Somebody is holding on to an old certificate, an old title, an old version of their resume that no longer represents who they've become. Update it. Your documentation is lagging behind your development. There is a woman believing for a child after a long wait. And I sense a shift in a medical report coming within this season. Pay close attention to your next appointment. Somebody has been praying generally when they need to start praying specifically. Name the amount, name the date, name the person. Specificity invites a specific answer. [music] There is a minister on this call who has been serving faithfully behind the scenes for years, watching others step into platforms while they remain unseen. Your visibility is not being withheld as punishment. It was simply scheduled for after this particular season of preparation and that season is ending. Somebody's relationship with a sibling has been strained by comparison, their success, your delay. God is healing that comparison from both directions. This season there is a person about to receive unexpected news from a government or legal process. Be ready to respond quickly when it comes. Don't let the opportunity sit unanswered. Somebody has chronic difficulty sleeping that started around the same time a major disappointment occurred. The two are connected. Healing the disappointment will heal the sleep. There is a young man whose father never affirmed him verbally and he has been unconsciously performing for approval that isn't coming from that source. Receive affirmation from your heavenly father tonight. It is enough. There is someone who has been quietly comparing their chapter 1 to someone else's chapter 20 on social media and it has slowly eroded their confidence without them even noticing. Close the comparison tab tonight. Your chapter is still being written and it was never meant to match anyone else's outline. [music] Somebody has an unfinished certification or course sitting at 70% completion for over a year. Finish it this month. The remaining 30% is smaller than it feels from where you are standing. There is a woman who has been the strong one for everybody else in her family for so long that nobody has thought to ask how she's actually doing. God is asking tonight. You are allowed to need support too. Somebody has been avoiding a difficult financial conversation with their spouse out of fear of conflict and the avoidance is costing more than the conversation ever would have it this week. There is a person who applied for something and never heard back and has quietly assumed rejection without confirmation. Followup. The silence was administrative, not a verdict. Somebody's car or primary mode of transportation has been breaking down intermittently, draining resources in small, frustrating amounts. I decree a full resolution either lasting repair or a complete replacement within this season in the name of Jesus. There is a man who has been carrying an old agreement with a business partner that quietly favors the other person far more than it favors him. Revisit the terms. You do not have to stay loyal to an imbalance. Somebody has been experiencing a strange heaviness specifically on Sunday nights or before the start of a new work week almost like dread with no clear cause. That is an assigned spirit not a personality trait. I break it now in the name of Jesus. There is a grandmother on this call praying for a grandchild who has drifted from the faith. I see that grandchild returning and I see it happening through an ordinary conversation, not a dramatic crisis. Keep praying quietly. The return is coming gently, not through tragedy. Somebody's one conversation away from a mentor who has been positioned to open doors you cannot open yourself. Say yes to the next invitation. You are tempted to decline out of social anxiety. There is a person whose chronic lower back or joint pain intensifies specifically during periods of stress. The physical and the emotional are connected in your body. Healing is coming to both at once. Let's close this in declaration and decree because a word must be sealed before it can be carried out of this room. I decree every level you have outgrown is officially behind you. I decree every excuse you have memorized is officially retired. I decree the mountain you have circled has released its grip on your feet. I decree new assignments, [music] new income brackets, new relationships, new territory, new health, new peace are now in active motion toward you. I decree what took others years will take you months and what took others months will take you weeks because God is redeeming time as part of this elevation. Deuteronomy 1:7 finishes the instruction we started with tonight. Turn you and take your journey and go to the mount of the Amorites. Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess it. The land was already set before them. The possessing was simply a matter of walking into what had already been decided. Church, your next level has already been set before you. It is not being negotiated in heaven right now. It has been decided. [music] Tonight is simply the turning. Stand to your feet wherever you are and say it with everything in you. I turn. I take my journey. I go in and I possess it. Enough is enough. And I receive the word spoken over my life this day. Father, we thank you for what has been settled tonight. Let no devil reverse what heaven has decreed. Let no delay dare to answer back to a word this final. Carry every person who received this word into the testimony that matches it. And let their life become the proof that when you say enough, heaven means it. In the matchless, unshakable name of Jesus Christ, we have prayed and we believe it is already so. Amen.
